commit_scope: Three more self-imposed blocks: the deploy declared a healthy API unstable because its 75-second window could not fit a cold API on a host that steals 60 % of its CPU; the Python API saturated its own loop under eight bot requests a minute, each tens of CPU-seconds, so ping and the health probe starved; pulse's round of eleven fetch workers every 30 seconds took three cores beside it. The serving window becomes 300 s with a 20 s local probe; the compose owner gives the Python API's routers an eight-request in-flight bound at Traefik (applied live by hand); pulse's round moves to every 180 s.
evidence_refs: Two manual roll-forwards on 2026-10-26 (872b08ef, de4dd0bb; CI's own of 026209f5) each recreated every container and ran the new code, yet ended FAIL in api_serving_window: three consecutive local (10 s) + public (15 s) pings within 75 s. The API's first minute after start saw /api/coherence/score, /api/contributors, /api/contributions at 21–24 s and /api/ping at 13–18 s; the script's bounded repair recreated the API again, and no revision was stamped (deployed_sha empty since 2026-10-23).

Load on the host reached 31 during a build and sat at 8–15 otherwise with 60 % steal; strace of the API's hottest thread showed 851 syscalls in 5 s and almost no file or SQL calls — pure Python CPU per request — while the access log held 42 requests in 5 minutes from Cloudflare addresses. With pulse paused the API still oscillated (ping 0.2 s → 15 s timeouts, 100–295 % CPU).
Pulse's steady cost is its round, not its listener: `docker top` during a round showed eleven `fetch.bml` workers plus `round.bml`, ~250–370 % CPU every 30 s, each worker a full fkwu boot.

Heals: api_serving_window deadline 75 → 300 s and the local probe 10 → 20 s (the public probe keeps its contracted 15 s; scripts/test_hostinger_deploy_form_paths.sh PASS); deployment_compose_care.bml dcc-api adds traefik.http.middlewares.api-inflight.inflightreq.amount=8 to the coherence-api and existing-api-reads routers (`./fkwu --check` passes) and was applied live from this checkout with activate [api] — the recreated container carries the labels; pulse/config.json interval_seconds 30 → 180 (reaches the image on the next build).
The compose owner is an operator door, not a deploy step: auto-deploy.sh never runs it, so router label changes reach the VPS only through `mode: apply` from a checkout.

local_validation.summary: bash -n and the deploy path test pass; fkwu --check on the compose owner and pulse main; the API bound verified live on the recreated container.

deploy_validation.summary: Manual roll-forward under nohup; expected: Deploy complete stamped; pulse round every 180 s.

e2e_validation.expected_behavior_delta: Deploys stamp their revision; at most eight requests in flight reach the Python API, the rest answer 429; pulse costs a sixth of before.
test_flows: for i in $(seq 1 12); do curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} ' https://api.coherencycoin.com/api/ping & done; wait
